messages:
alex: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to consolidate the pricing grid with the quota examples. Found the SDK snippet for quota headers is stale and the example call uses a removed header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421
monica: thanks alex. can you call out which header is removed? i can update the migration guide and the 'pricing tiers' section once i know all refs.
jordan: the old snippet references `X-Quota-Bucket`. new runtime sends `X-Redwood-Quota` and the shape changed (json blob). simplest fix is to show a parsing example in the SDK snippet.
jordan: ```js
// parse quota header
const quotaHeader = response.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota');
const quota = quotaHeader ? JSON.parse(quotaHeader) : null;
console.log(quota.remaining, quota.reset_ms);
```
ryan: also FYI the usage-tiers dashboard panel id changed last week (panel 13 -> panel 21). link in the doc still points to the old panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/usage/tiers?viewPanel=13 -> should be viewPanel=21.
alex: good catch, ryan. i'll update the PR description with the grafana link and the migration note about the header rename + shape change. also want to add a short note about burst behavior (how quota buckets are consumed during short spikes).
monica: can you paste a short sentence i can drop in? i want to keep it <=2 lines.
alex: "Short bursts consume from the per-minute bucket first; if exhausted, requests draw from the short-term burst allowance. See Admin dashboard -> Usage tiers for live bucket fill rates."
monica: perfect. i'm also going to add a tiny SDK snippet showing a defensive parse and a fallback when `quota.reset_ms` missing.
jordan: i'll push the snippet change to the PR branch and add a unit test for the code sample rendering.
docs-bot: docs deploy succeeded for ref/3421 — staging at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3421 :rocket:
ryan: after merging can we add a short redirect rule for the old grafana link? a few internal bookmarks still use it.
alex: yes, i'll ask infra to add a rewrite for the old panel id -> 21. tagged infra in the PR comments.
monica: will review and merge once jordan's snippet tests land. thanks all :thumbsup:
jordan: on it, should be a one-line change.
alex: thanks team — aiming to ship before EOD so billing docs and SDK samples are consistent for the release.
